newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kaman still in running for NZ order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kaman still in running for NZ order.

text.p: Kaman Corp said on Wednesday it was still in the running for a New Zealand helicopter order, despite a report that it had been eliminated.
"We feel we have a fairly good chance, but you never know until the announcement is made," Kaman regional manager Jack Costello told Reuters.

British industry magazine Flight International reported late last year that the Royal New Zealand Navy had chosen the rival GKN-Westland Super Lynx over Kaman's SH-2G Sea Sprite, but Costello said no decision had been announced.
Australia and New Zealand have collaborated on their selection of new navy helicopters and Australia last week announced its choice of the Sea Sprite.
Canberra said it would negotiate for 11 units with the possibility of repeat orders. Pending those negotiations, the value of the order is unknown.
New Zealand Defence Minister Paul East said on January 17 his government would take the Australian choice into consideration and announce its own decision within a few weeks.
